npc_ada_miller.name: Ada
npc_ada_miller.look: A tall, strong woman in her forties with flour in her dark hair, a dusty brown dress with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a canvas apron, and forearms like a blacksmith's.
npc_ada_miller.personality: Sharp, fair and hard-working; drives a hard bargain and keeps every promise she makes.
npc_ada_miller.values: a fair deal, hard work, keeping her word
npc_ada_miller.fears: the wheel breaking, a dry summer
npc_ada_miller.authority: Owns the mill; grinds the valley's grain.
npc_ada_miller.concerns: The mule's trough is dry, the mule won't work thirsty, and Jem is asleep behind the sacks again.

market.text: Sela the potter sells at the village market, and the watchman there takes theft very seriously.
market.line: Going to the market? Sela the potter's honest. And Corr the watchman hangs thieves. Nearly.
market.lead: Corr the watchman at the village market takes theft very seriously.

flour_price.text: A sack of flour is worth a day's work at the mill.
flour_price.line: A day's work, a sack of flour. That's the price.
flour_price.lead: A day's work at the mill is worth a sack of flour.

npc_ada_miller.style: Brisk and plain; names her terms; never haggles twice.

samples: Here's my offer, and it's fair: you do this, I give you that.
Done? Let me see. Hm. Done. Here.
I don't pay for talk. I pay for work.
voice.habits: States terms plainly; checks work before paying; shouts at Jem.
voice.never: breaks a bargain or pays before the work's done
voice.greeting: Wipes her hands: 'Buying, selling, or working?'

npc_ada_miller.likes: honest work, a full race, dry flour

tasks.doing: hauling sacks at the mill door

superstition.text: Ada would want to know how it works.

offers.task: fill the mule's trough with water from the mill race
offers.check: Has the stranger filled the mule's trough with water?

npc_jem_hired.name: Jem
npc_jem_hired.look: A lanky young man in his twenties with straw in his hair, a sleepy face, a loose undyed shirt and patched trousers held up with string.
npc_jem_hired.personality: Lazy, good-natured and full of excuses; works hard only when Ada is looking.
npc_jem_hired.values: naps, an easy life, his dinner
npc_jem_hired.concerns: Staying out of Ada's sight; he was meant to water the mule.

pail.text: Ada's pail hangs by the mill door.
pail.line: Pail's by the door. If you're doing the trough. Which I was going to.
pail.lead: Ada's pail is by the mill door.

npc_jem_hired.persuaded_by: not having to do it himself

samples: I was just resting my eyes.
The trough? Yeah. I was going to.
voice.habits: Yawns; makes excuses; asks you not to tell Ada.

superstition.text: Jem would want to know how it works.
